name: Adoor Gopalakrishnan
description: A landmark figure of Indian parallel cinema whose Malayalam films brought Kerala's social realities and human relationships to national and international audiences.
contribution: Helped establish Malayalam cinema as a major force in art and parallel cinema through precise, socially observant and psychologically rich filmmaking.

name: G. Aravindan
description: One of Malayalam cinema's most distinctive auteurs, known for poetic, philosophical and visually inventive filmmaking.
contribution: Expanded the expressive possibilities of Malayalam cinema by blending visual poetry, music, philosophy and unconventional storytelling.

name: Sathyan Anthikad
description: A celebrated filmmaker known for warm family dramas, social observation, humour and stories rooted in everyday Kerala life.
contribution: Made ordinary middle-class Kerala life a lasting subject of popular Malayalam cinema, balancing humour with social and emotional themes.

name: Priyadarshan
description: A prolific filmmaker who has worked across Malayalam, Hindi and Tamil cinema, particularly known for comedy and mainstream entertainment.
contribution: Helped take Malayalam filmmaking talent and storytelling into other Indian-language industries while creating commercially successful cinema.

name: Fazil
description: A major Malayalam filmmaker associated with emotionally rich family dramas, romances and enduring commercial films.
contribution: Shaped several generations of Malayalam popular cinema through character-driven storytelling and helped establish major acting careers.

name: Blessy
description: A filmmaker known for emotionally intense dramas exploring human resilience, relationships, morality and survival.
contribution: Brought a deeply character-centred and emotionally immersive approach to Malayalam cinema through intimate human stories and strong performances.

name: Lal Jose
description: A popular Malayalam director whose films combine accessible storytelling, social themes, humour and memorable characters.
contribution: An important part of contemporary Malayalam mainstream cinema, introducing fresh performers and delivering films across romance, drama and social themes.

name: Shaji Kailas
description: A leading commercial filmmaker associated with high-energy action dramas and politically charged mainstream Malayalam cinema.
contribution: Helped define the large-scale action and political thriller style of Malayalam cinema during the 1990s and 2000s.

name: Ranjith
description: A prominent filmmaker and screenwriter whose work spans literary dramas, political themes, satire and character-driven cinema.
contribution: Made a substantial contribution as both writer and director, helping shape modern Malayalam screenwriting and character-led storytelling.

name: Aashiq Abu
description: A key contemporary Malayalam filmmaker known for urban stories, strong visual design and socially engaged themes.
contribution: Influential in contemporary Malayalam cinema through distinctive visual storytelling, collaborative filmmaking and socially relevant subjects.

name: Amal Neerad
description: A visually distinctive filmmaker associated with stylised cinematography, action, atmosphere and technically polished filmmaking.
contribution: Brought a strongly visual, genre-oriented sensibility to Malayalam cinema and popularised a stylised approach to action and crime filmmaking.

name: Anjali Menon
description: A leading contemporary filmmaker known for relationship-driven stories, ensemble characters and emotionally nuanced writing.
contribution: Brought a strong voice to contemporary Malayalam cinema through stories about friendship, family, identity and changing social relationships.

name: Dileesh Pothan
description: A prominent new-generation filmmaker known for naturalistic performances, grounded characters and sharp observations of everyday life.
contribution: Helped popularise grounded, realistic filmmaking in contemporary Malayalam cinema through character-driven storytelling.

name: Lijo Jose Pellissery
description: An acclaimed filmmaker known for unconventional narratives, ensemble performances, kinetic staging and adventurous genre experimentation.
contribution: Pushed Malayalam cinema toward bold visual language, experimental structures and internationally recognised auteur filmmaking.

name: Jeo Baby
description: A contemporary filmmaker known for socially observant stories and films that question family structures, gender roles and relationships.
contribution: Contributed to socially conscious Malayalam cinema by turning everyday domestic and relationship issues into accessible, discussion-provoking stories.

name: Basil Joseph
description: A filmmaker who combines accessible humour and emotional storytelling with ambitious genre filmmaking.
contribution: Demonstrated that Malayalam cinema could combine local humour and emotional warmth with large-scale genre entertainment, notably through Minnal Murali.

name: Martin Prakkat
description: A filmmaker known for character-focused stories, travel, friendship and visually polished contemporary dramas.
contribution: Contributed to modern Malayalam cinema through emotionally accessible stories with strong visual settings and memorable character journeys.

name: Mahesh Narayanan
description: A filmmaker and editor known for tightly constructed narratives, political themes and contemporary social dramas.
contribution: Brought an editor's sense of structure and pace to Malayalam filmmaking while addressing displacement, politics, conflict and social realities.

name: Jude Anthany Joseph
description: A contemporary Malayalam filmmaker known for emotionally accessible stories and large-scale human dramas.
contribution: Combined mainstream accessibility with stories centred on human courage and collective resilience, notably in 2018 and his later work Thudakkam.

name: Chidambaram S. Poduval
description: A contemporary filmmaker known for rooted characters, regional texture and stories inspired by real social environments.
contribution: Brought strong regional authenticity and ensemble storytelling to contemporary Malayalam cinema, especially with Manjummel Boys.

name: Ratheesh Balakrishnan Poduval
description: A distinctive contemporary filmmaker known for deadpan humour, unusual worlds and inventive visual storytelling.
contribution: Expanded Malayalam comedy through eccentric characters, genre play and carefully designed fictional worlds.
